reviews.title: Buy a better brand UPDATED 3-24-26
reviews.comment: Wires too short and horrible instructions Updated 3-24-26: A representative reached out to me regarding my review. After discussing the issues we reached an amicable agreement and I'm very pleased with the results. Special thanks to Rika whom took the time to work out issues and make it right. Suggestions: Maybe include wiring extensions so as to work on all cases including full ATX. Instructions Manual: Perhaps make the directions more concise and understandable to include pictures/diagrams that all types of users/builders would find helpful. While many of us are tech savvy not all people.
reviews.author: Sam

reviews.title: No customer service, stop working very quickly.
reviews.comment: I had some issues with two of my three fans stopping working and I was outside of my return window but the company reached out to me and offered me a full refund. I've never had that happen before so I was thoroughly impressed.
